# DevRox — AI, Automation & Software Engineering Studio

> DevRox (DevRox Technologies, founded 2016) is a remote-first AI, automation and software engineering studio based in Lahore, Pakistan, serving clients worldwide — primarily in the USA and Europe. We design and build AI-powered applications, intelligent automations, digital products and scalable software systems.
> Website: https://thedevrox.com

## Services

- AI Agent Development — https://thedevrox.com/services/ai-agents
  Custom AI agents: support agents, workflow agents, multi-agent systems with human-in-the-loop controls.
- AI Voice Agent Development — https://thedevrox.com/services/ai-voice-agents
  Production voice AI for inbound call handling, lead qualification and appointment booking (Twilio, ElevenLabs, OpenAI).
- Zapier to n8n Migration Service — https://thedevrox.com/services/zapier-to-n8n-migration
  Zero-downtime migration from Zapier to self-hosted n8n; typical savings of 80–90% on automation platform costs.
- Workflow Automation Services — https://thedevrox.com/services/workflow-automation
  n8n, Make and Zapier workflow automation with monitoring, alerting and ongoing maintenance retainers.
- GoHighLevel Automation Agency — https://thedevrox.com/services/gohighlevel-automation
  GoHighLevel CRM setup, follow-up sequences, integrations and migrations for agencies and SMBs.
- AI Automation Services — https://thedevrox.com/services/ai-automation
  End-to-end AI automation programs: process mapping, build, and iteration.
- CRM & API Integration Services — https://thedevrox.com/services/crm-api-integrations
  HubSpot, Salesforce, GoHighLevel and custom API integrations.

## Ideal clients

- US and European small-to-mid businesses that need AI or automation built and shipped, not just advised on.
- Agencies and local businesses (real estate, home services, contractors, professional services) losing revenue to missed calls, slow follow-up, or manual processes.
- Teams paying painful per-task SaaS automation bills (Zapier) who want self-hosted alternatives.
- Businesses comfortable working with a remote-first delivery team; all engagements are in English with one-business-day response times.

## Proof of work (selected)

- FrontDesk AI — multi-tenant SaaS: configure an AI agent, embed chat + voice-call widget (Retell AI) on any website; captures leads, transcripts and bookings. One script tag to install.
- Northgate Property Group — AI voice agent handling the majority of first-contact calls (testimonial: "customers rarely notice the transition" to a human).
- NexusOps — enterprise multi-agent orchestration platform (triage, support, sales qualification, governance); 78.4% autonomous containment rate.
- Detroit Architect — AI chatbot for a licensed Detroit architecture practice.
